title: OWNER (CrowdWorks only): allow mac-local to submit CrowdWorks proposals, or send the 2 ready drafts yourself
detail: First CrowdWorks scan (10/08 13:20 JST, dedicated crowdworks-profile, logged in) found 2 GO requests; drafts are ready in marketing/2026-10/h1/screens/crowdworks-2026-10-08.md (Draft A: https://crowdworks.jp/public/jobs/13513659 PDF→Word ¥15,000, deadline to apply 10/10; Draft B: https://crowdworks.jp/public/jobs/13513520 drama classification ¥8,000, apply by 10/12). Typing into the CrowdWorks 応募 form was blocked by the Mac's Claude Code auto-mode classifier ('Unrequested Commit in a Connected App') — a runtime permission boundary mac-local must not bypass (same situation as owner-coconala-proposal-permission on Coconala, 10/02). Choose one: (a) paste the 2 drafts yourself on crowdworks.jp (~5 min, price/date in the file); or (b) allow unattended CrowdWorks proposal submission for the mac-local supervisor's Claude runs (permission rule for the playwright-crowdworks MCP browser tools in the Mac's Claude Code settings, or extend PG-1 to CrowdWorks explicitly in ops/2026-10/PERMISSIONS.md) — then every future CrowdWorks proposal goes out under PG-1 conditions without you.
